name: WordPress stats
description: Site-scoped daily views, visitors and seven-day chart.
template:
<Stack data-gp="wordpress-stats" p={6} gap={5} style={{fontFamily:"inherit",width:"100%",boxSizing:"border-box",minWidth:0}}>
<Group justify="space-between" gap={4} wrap="nowrap"><Anchor href="https://wordpress.com/stats/day/blog.example.net" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" c="inherit" style={{textDecoration:"none"}}><Group gap={5} wrap="nowrap"><TablerIcon name="chart-line" size={15}/><Text size="xs" fw={700}>WordPress stats</Text></Group></Anchor><RefreshButton requestId="stats" size="xs"/></Group>
{status.stats?.ok === false ? <Text size="xs" c="red">Stats feed unavailable</Text> : !data.stats ? <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Loading stats…</Text> : data.stats.state === "not_connected" ? <Text size="xs" c="yellow">WordPress authorization required</Text> : data.stats.state !== "ready" ? <Text size="xs" c="red">WordPress stats unavailable</Text> : !data.stats.summary ? <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">No daily statistics available</Text> : <Stack gap={5}>
<Group justify="space-between" gap={3}><Text size="xs" c="dimmed" lh={1.1}>{"Latest day · " + data.stats.summary.date.slice(5)}</Text><Text size="xs" c="dimmed" lh={1.1}>blog.example.net</Text></Group>
<SimpleGrid cols={3} spacing={4}><Stack gap={1}><Text size="xs" c="dimmed" lh={1.1}>Views</Text><Text size="sm" fw={700} lh={1.1} c="teal">{data.stats.summary.views}</Text></Stack><Stack gap={1}><Text size="xs" c="dimmed" lh={1.1}>Visitors</Text><Text size="sm" fw={700} lh={1.1} c="teal">{data.stats.summary.visitors}</Text></Stack><Stack gap={1}><Text size="xs" c="dimmed" lh={1.1}>7-day views</Text><Text size="sm" fw={700} lh={1.1} c="teal">{data.stats.summary.totalViews}</Text></Stack></SimpleGrid>
<Group h={25} align="flex-end" wrap="nowrap" gap={4}>{(data.stats.days ?? []).map(d => <Box key={d.date} title={d.date + " · " + d.views + " views · " + d.visitors + " visitors"} aria-label={d.date + ": " + d.views + " views, " + d.visitors + " visitors"} style={{flex:1,minWidth:0}}><Box h={Math.max(2,Math.round(d.views / Math.max(1,data.stats.summary.maxViews) * 25))} style={{backgroundColor:"var(--mantine-color-teal-5)",borderRadius:"2px"}}/></Box>)}</Group>
<Group justify="space-between" gap={3}><Text size="xs" c="dimmed" lh={1.1}>{data.stats.days[0].date.slice(5)}</Text><Text size="xs" c="dimmed" lh={1.1}>{data.stats.days[data.stats.days.length-1].date.slice(5)}</Text></Group>
</Stack>}
</Stack>
